mapper.sql: message.id, message.conversation_id, message.sender_user_id, sender.nickname as sender_nickname, sender.avatar_url as sender_avatar_url, message.message_type, message.body, message.shared_content_id, shared_content.title as shared_content_title, shared_content.cover_url as shared_content_cover_url, shared_content.author_user_id as shared_content_author_user_id, shared_author.nickname as shared_content_author_nickname, message.client_message_id, message.created_at, message.sequence_no
mapper.insert: insert into chat_conversations ( id, conversation_type, direct_user_one_id, direct_user_two_id ) values (#{conversationId}, 'direct', #{firstUserId}, #{secondUserId})
insert into chat_conversations ( id, conversation_type, name, owner_user_id ) values (#{conversationId}, 'group', #{name}, #{ownerUserId})
mapper.update: update chat_conversations set conversation_state = 'dissolved', dissolved_at = current_timestamp, dissolved_by_user_id = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{conversationId} and conversation_state = 'active'
mapper.select: select membership.user_id, users.nickname, users.avatar_url, membership.member_role, membership.joined_at from chat_conversation_members membership join users on users.id = membership.user_id where membership.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and membership.member_state = 'active' order by case when membership.member_role = 'owner' then 0 else 1 end, membership.joined_at, membership.user_id
